notes.pin_policy: Unattended runs use these exact versions from the lockfile. Do not resolve latest on each story.
notes.vite8_node: Vite 8 engines are ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0 (Node 24 is legal for Vite). QMX CI still uses Node 22.12.0 from ADR-0026.
notes.vite_plugin_svelte: 6.2.1 peers vite ^6.3 || ^7 only. Vite 8 requires @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte 7.x (7.3.1; peers vite ^8 and svelte ^5.46.4). Svelte 5.57.1 satisfies that. Kit 2.70.3 peers already include vite ^8 and plugin ^7.
notes.vitest: Vitest 3.x does not support Vite 8 Rolldown. 5.0.2 peers vite ^6.4 || ^7 || ^8.
notes.storybook: Do not create storybook@latest. Catalog pin is Storybook 10.6.0 with @storybook/sveltekit 10.6.0 (peers svelte ^5, vite ^5||^6||^7||^8). Storybook 8 is the v8 line (Vite 5 era), not this stack. Install only when a shared-library story asks; local catalog route is enough for factory-test.
